context: New BNY custody, C2FO Instant Pay, Coinbase RLUSD distribution, Ripple OCC charter, Circle Arc, SBI multi-rail and SBIC identity evidence materially expands the institutional relationship graph. These events must not be collapsed into one XRP-demand signal.
decisions: Separate custody, issuance, settlement, collateral, liquidity provision, exchange listing, network validation, and actual XRP acquisition into different graph edge types and time series.
Classify BNY XRP custody as live institutional safekeeping access, not disclosed XRP holdings, purchase demand or collateral acceptance.
Classify C2FO Instant Pay as an XRPL/RLUSD settlement initiative funded by participating capital providers; do not attribute C2FO's historical $520B working-capital access to XRPL or XRP.
Treat RLUSD settlement and XRP-native network fees/reserves as separate mechanisms. No XRP bridge role is claimed for C2FO Instant Pay without transaction evidence.

Treat Coinbase as a multi-issuer distributor: Circle USDC arrangement renewed on the same terms, RLUSD added to Prime/Exchange/Retail, and Arc exchange access listed. Do not infer Circle displacement.
Keep Circle Arc separate from XRPL. SBI validator and Coinbase exchange-access roles are not interchangeable.
Treat SBI as multi-rail across Ripple/RLUSD, Circle/USDC/Arc, JPYSC/Startale and Open Standard; consortium co-participation is weaker than a bilateral commercial contract.
Resolve SBIC as Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. for the ChatGPT seminar context; never merge it with SBI Holdings or OpenAI.
Treat Ripple National Trust Bank's OCC charter effective date as confirmed, while operational launch and reserve migration remain unknown; RLUSD issuer remains Standard Custody & Trust Company.
Cluster Ripple Swell announcements for source-independence and event-study purposes; do not treat correlated announcements as independent confirmations.
Keep Binance OI and ETF flow provider universes separate. No market feature is admitted until point-in-time completeness, synchronization, leakage controls and out-of-sample value are established.
invariants: Institutional custody does not equal asset purchase or collateralization.
RLUSD settlement on XRPL does not equal XRP bridge demand.
C2FO historical working-capital volume does not equal new Instant Pay capital or XRPL volume.
Coinbase RLUSD collateral functionality was future at announcement, not live.
Circle's USDC-on-platform metric is not Coinbase AOP.
Company-wide Ripple product revenue/transaction claims are not XRP-specific.
ETF flows and perpetual OI remain source/venue-scoped.
Forecasts require fixed horizon, target, cutoff, assumptions, alternatives, calibrated probability and later outcome.
